text: Educational Objective The Master of Business Administration Degree for foreign students aims to train high-level and specialized personnel with a good command of basic theories and systematic professional knowledge, and understanding of the frontier trends in the profession in all kinds of enterprises and various areas, including marketing management, financial management, strategy management, production management, technological innovation management, human resources management, and investment decision management. Research Orientation ● Human Resources Development and Management ● Organization and Enterprise Culture ● Marketing Management ● Strategy for Enterprise Development ● Enterprise Information System ● Corporation Finance Curriculum Chinese, Research Methods of Management, Advanced Management, Management Economics, Marketing Management, Strategic Management for Enterprises, Introduction to China, Management Information System, China: Culture& Enterprises, Accounting, Organizational Behavior, Project Management, Development and Management of Human Resources, E-commerce and web marketing, International Trade and Finance, etc.. Practical Operation During the school years, foreign students should investigate at least three units (enterprises, financial units and departments of government, etc.). Before writing thesis, students should carry out investigation on the areas of their selected topics. Scientific Research and Thesis During the school years, all the students should actively write and put forward papers on their fields or their related fields in Chinese or foreign academic publications or academic conferences, and should also take active part in research tasks undertaken by their advisers.
